recognition.title: signBridge
recognition.subtitle: Real-Time ISL Recognition
recognition.description: Built and trained a real-time Indian Sign Language recognition system using a custom Swin3D + BiLSTM model. The model was exposed through a custom Flask API and integrated into a Flutter application.
recognition.techStack: Python, PyTorch, Swin3D, BiLSTM, Flask, Flutter, OpenCV

technicalDetails.problem: Real-time Indian Sign Language recognition requires processing video sequences through a deep model and delivering results to a mobile application with minimal latency.
technicalDetails.solution: Trained Swin3D + BiLSTM spatial-temporal model in PyTorch on custom ISL video dataset, exposed inference via custom Flask REST API, and built Flutter mobile frontend.
technicalDetails.result: Functional end-to-end pipeline from mobile camera video input to real-time sign label recognition in Flutter application.

production.title: Sign Language Pose Generation
production.subtitle: SOKE / MotionVQVAE Generation
production.description: Reproduced and extended a SOKE-based Sign Language Production pipeline for Indian Sign Language, using SMPL-X representations and MotionVQVAE-based discrete motion tokenization.
production.techStack: Python, PyTorch, MotionVQVAE, VQ-VAE, SMPL-X, Deep Learning

technicalDetails.problem: Generating realistic and accurate 3D sign language motion sequences from text requires understanding both body and hand kinematics in a discrete, learnable representation.
technicalDetails.solution: Built custom SMPL-X fusion pipeline (SMPLest-X body + HaMeR/WiLoR hands via inverse kinematics) converting 6,200+ ISL videos into clean 3D pose sequences. Designed and trained three-branch MotionVQVAE tokenizer and autoregressive SLP transformer.
technicalDetails.result: Reduced mean MPJPE to 39.80mm (7.04mm body) on held-out sequences across 6 controlled experiments. Established a 17-18% token-accuracy baseline.

technicalDetails.problem: Information stored across multiple documents is difficult to search and synthesize efficiently.
technicalDetails.solution: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline supporting PDF, DOCX, TXT and CSV documents. about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm Abhay Singh, an engineering student focused on AI/ML engineering and intelligent systems.

I build end-to-end AI applications spanning deep learning, computer vision, LLM/RAG systems, and real-time inference. My work ranges from training custom deep-learning models and developing retrieval pipelines to deploying models through APIs and integrating them into applications.
I've also worked on deep-learning research involving sign-language production, motion tokenization, and pose generation, with an interest in understanding models beyond simply using pretrained APIs.
Currently, I'm focused on strengthening my foundations in AI, systems, and software engineering while building practical projects that can move from research ideas to usable systems.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
experience.subtitle: Indian Institute of Technology (BHU), Varanasi
details: Reproduced and extended the SOKE sign-language generation framework for Indian Sign Language, building a custom SMPL-X fusion pipeline (SMPLest-X body + HaMeR/WiLoR hand estimators via inverse kinematics) converting 6,200+ raw ISL videos into clean 3D pose sequences.

Designed and trained a three-branch MotionVQVAE motion tokenizer (independent body/hand codebooks, feature-wise normalization) across 6 controlled experiments, reducing mean MPJPE to 39.80mm (7.04mm body) on held-out sequences.

Reproduced the autoregressive SLP transformer; training a text-to-motion-token generation pipeline with teacher forcing and three independent prediction heads, establishing a 17–18% token-accuracy baseline, backed by a custom experiment-management framework for versioning and reproducibility.
